versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11002 If the parameters in a call of SyncScheduleTable are valid, SyncScheduleTable shall provide the Operating System module with the current synchronization count for the given ScheduleTable . (It is used to synchronize the processing of the Schedule Table to the synchronization Counter .)
